### User need

What are you trying to do, and what happens today?

### Proposed behavior

Describe the expected workflow and alternatives considered.

### Compatibility evidence, if applicable

Link behavioral observations, protocol documentation or independently derived vectors. Distinguish confirmed behavior from UNKNOWNs. Do not submit vendor code/assets, private captures or speculative firmware commands as established facts.
